ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** since `tend map 19` and `tend map 20` (the owner, Nov 18: "Allow it"), with VoiceOver, then TalkBack: on a later walk past a spot where an earlier walk kept one voice memo, touch its memory pin; on Chronicle's map tap one star, touch it, then touch another star, then tap that one. **Expect:** the memory pin says "Memory: a voice memo, <the part of the day>. Open" as one label; the selected star says its name and "selected" (`accessibilityState={{ selected }}` on the star's `pinHit` View, which re-renders inside its Marker with no new key), the other says no state, and selecting it moves "selected" to it. (tend map 19, 20)

- **T? [owner] `.claude/rules/map.md` is past the 20,000-character warning: split it by topic** (2026-11-18)
  Area: map. Seen: `npm run check:docs` after `tend map 20`: "`.claude/rules/map.md` is 20570 characters, past the 20000 warning (it fails at 40000)"; it was 19,752 on `main` before this run's two lines (the tap refs and audit 41, the selected star). Rests on: decision 0173, "past the warning a file is split before more is added; the loop files a split as `T [owner]`"; the loop only adds to rule files (0135), so it cannot split one.
  Recommended: move "Icons and pins" (with the run's two new bullets) and "Map staples" into a new `.claude/rules/pins.md` whose `paths:` name `components/map/`, `CapturePinView.tsx`, `StarView.tsx` and `lib/pins.ts`, leaving `map.md` the map component, its budget, the compass, swipes and borders; no app surface, so no `/vision` verdict.
  Precedent: none (a repository document, not a job a person does in the app).
  Otherwise: let `map.md` run toward the 40,000-character limit and split it then.

**Nov 18, `/tend map --deploy=main`, four of the map's low `[loop]` items** (opened from `17bcbccb`, rebased on `ea3bba09`; no sweep, lenses 1-7 not run; aimed at DEFERRED's `[loop]` lows in "Map, walk screen and motion polish"; the faster lane of decision 0181).
- `tend map 17`: the web map's pin, star and "?" taps read their handlers from refs filled in `useLayoutEffect`, as the map's own are (audit 8), so a tap right after a render never reaches the previous handler.
- `tend map 18`: the worker test reaches the web map's one `setWorkerUrl(mapWorkerUrl(…, getVersion()))` call; it fails with the call back on the old address.
- `tend map 19`: a memory pin of one moment says "Memory: a voice memo", from the table a pin of several says "Memories: a photo and a note" from (amends RB7, MR2). Spoken words only.
- `tend map 20`: the selected star is told to a screen reader, on the owner's answer in person (Nov 18): "Allow it". On the web its button carries `aria-current="true"` (spoken "current"), on native `accessibilityState={{ selected }}`.
- The review (one round, the `auditor`; four low, all accepted), in the 20 commit: `tend map audit 40` (every fill of a tap ref sits in a layout effect's own body; every marker click reads its ref), `audit 41` (accepted as is: a tap in the frame between commit and marker sync is dropped, never stale; recorded in `map.md`), `audit 42` (the worker call's names are maplibre-gl's and the types' own; one call), and F43 (the 19 test names what it amends). Lines added to `map.md` and `memories.md`.
- Filed: T34 [owner] (`map.md` passed `check:docs`'s 20,000-character warning with this run's lines: a split by topic is yours, decision 0173); a native check under "Map layers and markers" (the memory pin's words and the star's "selected" with VoiceOver and TalkBack). Noted, not built: `formatDistance`'s no-break space. A change in the function itself breaks literal checks in 8 unit-test files and 9 journeys, the planner's among them, which a parallel run held.
